summary: Gain, balance or mono pan, width 0–200 %, bass mono below a frequency, polarity invert per channel, channel swap and DC removal, each exact (gain in 0.1 dB steps), and a mid/side matrix (encode or decode), so any stereo machine between two Utilities works on mid and side. Zero latency; at its defaults it passes the input bit for bit. Use it for gain staging and stereo fixes as one-parameter moves: trim a track, narrow or widen it, make the lows mono, fix a flipped channel, EQ or compress the side alone.
use_for: Gain staging and stereo fixes: trim, balance, width, bass mono, polarity and mid/side conversion.

parameters.name: Gain
parameters.description: Output gain in 0.1 dB steps, −60 … +24 dB (bottom: −∞, silence)
parameters.how: Sets the output level from -60 to +24 dB; the bottom of the range is silence.
parameters.sound: It makes the sound louder or quieter without changing its tone.

parameters.name: Pan
parameters.how: Moves the sound from 100 % left to 100 % right.
parameters.sound: The sound shifts across the stereo field.

parameters.name: Pan law
parameters.description: Balance: the far side fades linearly, 0 dB at centre (stereo sources). Mono pan: sums to mono, sine/cosine law, −3 dB per side at centre
parameters.how: Chooses Balance, where the far side fades, or Mono pan, which sums to mono and pans with a sine/cosine law.
parameters.sound: Balance suits stereo sources; Mono pan suits a single mono source and keeps its loudness even as it moves.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Side signal × width: 0 % is mono, 100 % unchanged, 200 % twice the side
parameters.how: Scales the side signal, from 0 % (mono) through 100 % (unchanged) to 200 % (twice as wide).
parameters.sound: Lower values narrow the sound towards mono; higher values make it broader.

parameters.name: Bass mono
parameters.description: Makes everything below Bass mono freq mono
parameters.how: Makes everything below Bass mono freq mono.
parameters.sound: The bass is centred and solid, which helps on small speakers and in clubs.

parameters.name: Bass mono freq
parameters.description: Below this the side signal is removed (4th-order Butterworth high-pass, −3 dB here)
parameters.how: Sets the frequency, from 20 to 500 Hz, below which the sound is made mono.
parameters.sound: Higher values centre more of the low end, lower values keep more of it wide.

parameters.name: Invert L
parameters.description: Flips the polarity of the left input (before Swap)
parameters.how: Flips the polarity of the left input.
parameters.sound: The left channel is upside down, which can fix thin, phasey sound when two sources cancel.

parameters.name: Invert R
parameters.description: Flips the polarity of the right input (before Swap)
parameters.how: Flips the polarity of the right input.
parameters.sound: The right channel is upside down, which can fix thin, phasey sound when two sources cancel.

parameters.name: Swap
parameters.how: Swaps the left and right channels.
parameters.sound: Left and right trade places in the stereo image.

parameters.name: DC removal
parameters.description: Removes DC offset: 2nd-order high-pass at 5 Hz (20 Hz passes within 0.02 dB)
parameters.how: Removes any constant offset with a gentle 5 Hz high-pass.
parameters.sound: Clicks and wasted headroom caused by DC offset disappear; the audible sound is unchanged.

parameters.name: Matrix
parameters.description: Mid/side for the machines between two Utilities. Encode M/S: after the other stages, the output carries mid (L + R)/2 on the left and side (L − R)/2 on the right. Decode M/S: before them, the input is read as mid and side and turned back into L = M + S, R = M − S. Off: left and right as they are
parameters.how: Turns left/right into mid/side (Encode) or back (Decode), for processing between two Utilities.
parameters.sound: Between an encode and a decode, a machine in the chain works on the centre and the sides separately.
